name: Super Hydorah: Collector's Edition
summary:
An evil force has launched an invasion over the Omios star! Fly with the space fleet in a campaign to liberate planets, destroy enemy bases and discover the mysterious force behind the attack. Biomechanical enemies, space creatures, exotic planets and climatic threats are waiting for you, so select a route, equip your ship and prepare to die!

The Collector's Edition includes:
- Physical copy of Super Hydorah for Switch with reversible cover
- Super Hydorah Game Manual
- Super Hydorah Complete Original Soundtrack
- Arcade Cut-Out
- Super Hydorah "Making Of" Book
- Super Hydorah Keychain
- Omios Star and the Juggernaut Mother Ship Sticker
